title: Big Boi Blower Mini Junior - Car Drying System $160 + $12 Delivery ($0 C&C) @ Repco
body:
Deal: Big Boi Blower Mini Junior - Car Drying System $160 + $12 Delivery ($0 C&C) @ Repco

[banterbants] Good if your car has ceramic coat, ppf or you're a regular user of spray sealants. On a car without any of the previously mentioned things, it'll take forever to dry your car.
[Soldier] Anyone have some user review on this??
I’ve been eyeing it for a while
[b0nd] I have it, works great… blows a bit warm air which helps drying quicker than a leaf blower 😆
[Soldier] You have this mini junior model? There’s hardly any details about it. Most about the “mini”
[Kelvin H.] I’ve been using one for a few years now, it’s great. I’ve also found warm air helps dry the car quicker with less water spotting. I was using a leaf blower before but found it heavy, less manoeuvrable and weaker than the Bigboi. The only advantage is that the leaf blower was battery powered.
[Soldier] You have this mini junior model? There’s hardly any details about it. Most about the “mini”
[beatsntoons] leaf blowers tend to also push dust onto the car because of no or weak filters. If you've polished your car, that's not great.
I have the Buddi version of this, have had it for about 4 years I think. Great device, and useful around the house as well. I use it to dry an SUV so even that's plenty enough. This one will be better.
[finger] I just use my leaf blower and finish with and a microfibre towel.
[krisspy] Why wouldn't it? It blows harder than this
Just gotta be careful of it launching debris into the paint
[tight-ass] I've got one of the Ego cordless leaf blowers and it works great. Previously I used an air compressor, but the cordless blower is so much easier and better in every way.
I bought a short / stubby attachment from Amazon with a rubberised tip so that it doesn't scratch the paintwork if you accidently hit it.
[IlIlIl IlI llIIIl] I have a 56v Ego blower too and a Rockwell 18v blower. The Ego is the only one that is worth using. 18v blowers aren't powerful enough.
Also ceramic coating is better than a sealant.
My 3yr old car with a cheap Mr Fix 9H ceramic coating and a Turtle Wax Graphene spray sealant is much easier to blow dry than my few month old car with just the Turtle Wax hybrid solutions sealant.
Kind of regretting not using Mr Fix 9H on my new car but didn't have the time.
[finger] @IlIlIl IlI llIIIl: Yeah i use my ego leaf blower.
Just as a side note i didn't downvote this so not sure what happened here.
[viper8548] kek my wolfbox does the job drying the car
[Lt Frank Drebin] Yep. Use it too for all the nooks and crannies
[Juniormin] unlelss you have a luxury car, and you have the time and space, otherwise it's an overkill, peroid
[khey] something that you take to be more misculini
[kaybrr] Product sounds like its by the same people behind PupNPussy?
[p3r514n] "Don't stress, your options are below:"
Lol what?
[dandoon] Yeah, I have the bigboi blowR. I kinda got excited and picked it up about 6mo ago off ebay. it's "good" and it's nice that it has the heating feature… I guess. I use it all the time when i wash my car but it's definitely not worth it when you can get a leaf blower electric or petrol which will far outlive this machine. and if your goal is to blast water out of the crevices, wolfbox is more than sufficient. I like that i don't have to touch my car to dry it, but I don't think it's worth the money when you have better options.
Also, I find in certain circumstances the hose resonates and you get a hella good whistle, almost like the feedback of a microphone that won't go away unless you extend/contract the hose and/or shift your distance from the surface you're drying.
If you want it, get it, but you can get more useful things otherwise.
[bangzzz] After watching this company aggressively defend themselves publicly on detailing Facebook groups and blaming the users for common defects/issues with some of their products I will be keeping my distance.
[jayz] I've had a Blowr for maybe 2 or 3 years. It's fine. It's pretty loud.
I would probably get a E-Ego if I were to buy again.
These days I just final rinse with demineralised water so I don't have to bother drying.
[anthman] How does this compare to animal dryer? Very similar design, also has heating
[MS Paint] This one will blow your Chihuahua overs the neighbours fence
[Maloo] Read the reviews on the Repco website. There’s a positive one there from a dog groomer.
[Nubbin] One of the user reviews:
Substitute of a cattle blower
Anonymous
2 years ago
We bought this a couple of months back for my daughter to use on our Scottish Highland Cattle at shows. I wasn't willing to pay nearly $1000 for the "Cattle brand" ones and have found this one to be extremely handy! We even get compliments about it due to it's compact size and being able to fit into a large tool box. We purchased the wheel base also and this means my daughter can move around the cattle with ease and not having to pick the blower up manually to move. We also use it on our petting zoo sheep also and blows the sheep's wool out to be very fluffy. We are just about to purchase another for our other daughter so there is no waiting for one to finish before being able to use.
Yes, I recommend this product.
[liam2040] great, just when i thought this was overkill for the car, i need one for the dog.
[Lord Ra] I use mine for the dog, he comes out very soft and fluffy.
